Because the sum over k=0,...,n is finite, linearity of the integral justifies interchanging the finite sum and the integral: sum_{k=0}^{n} (-1)^k binom(n,k) ∫_0^1 x^k dx = ∫_0^1 sum_{k=0}^{n} (-1)^k binom(n,k) x^k dx. The integral evaluates as ∫_0^1 (1-x)^n dx = ∫_0^1 u^n du = 1/(n+1).
